items.title: Peter LaCaze Interview, 1972-01-27
items.q: No, Lola, we had a band called the Lola Band.

ctx.x: Did Russ play with your band? Russ, yeah, yeah. You mean the Supreme Band possibly?
No, Lola, we had a band called the Lola Band. That was with Eddie Jackson too. Eddie Jackson was a manager with my college, you know.
But anyway, you went to Duck Owners, and how long did you stay with anything?
